1. This permission may be cited as “Permission to disburse under the ﬁ fth supplementary ﬁ nancial statement -2024 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council” and come in to operation from 12.09.2024.

2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Fifty Two Billion Eight Hundred and Seventy Two Million Four Hundred and, Thirty Eight Thousand One Hundred and Seventy One and Cents Eighty Two only (Rs. 52,872,438,171.82) for the service of the period beginning on 01st of January, 2024 and ending 31st December 2024, which is speciﬁ ed as “Financial Year 2024” in the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue- Expenditure Estimates prepared for the year 2024, is hereby amended as, Rupees Fifty Three Billion Three Hundred Million Nine Hundred and Forty Three Thousand Sixty Eight and Cents Eighty Two only (Rs. 53,300,943,068.82) and grant permission to the Chief Secretary of this Province and other Accounting Oﬃ cers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

Nൺඏංඇ Dංඌඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ, Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to disburse as per the Fifth Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2024, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27(a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Rupees Fifty Three Billion Three Hundred Million Nine Hundred and Forty Three Thousand Sixty Eight and Cents Eighty Two only (Rs. 53,300,943,068.82) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 01st of January, 2024 and end on 31st of December, 2024.

This permission will be valid till 31st December, 2024 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
Nൺඏංඇ Dංඌඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ, Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province.

I do hereby approve to amend the advance account limits for the year 2024 stated in the Sixth Schedule of the ﬁ fth Supplementary Financial Statement for the year 2024, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27(a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.
Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.
